zte.name: ZTE
zte.description: ZTE Corporation is a Chinese partially state-owned technology company specializing in telecommunications. Founded in 1985, it is listed on the Hong Kong and Shenzhen Stock Exchanges.

zaporizhstal.name: Zaporizhstal
zaporizhstal.description: Zaporizhstal Iron and Steel Works is a steel mill based in Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine. Founded in 1933, it became the country's fourth-largest steel maker until operations stopped in 2026 due to the ongoing Russian war.

zalando.name: Zalando
zalando.description: Zalando SE is a German multinational e-commerce company headquartered in Berlin, specializing in fashion, beauty, and footwear. It is Europe's largest online fashion retailer and operates in 30 European markets with a large active customer base.

zhenhua-port-machinery-company.name: Zhenhua Port Machinery Company
zhenhua-port-machinery-company.description: Shanghai Zhenhua Heavy Industries Company Limited (ZPMC) is a Chinese state-owned engineering company and the world's largest manufacturer of cranes and large steel structures. In 2015, it accounted for about 75% of the world market share for container cranes.

zaz.name: ZAZ
zaz.description: ZAZ, or Zaporizhzhia Automobile Building Plant, is Ukraine's main automobile manufacturer based in Zaporizhzhia. It produces cars, buses, and trucks. The company is also known by the name of its former parent company, AvtoZAZ.

zendesk.name: Zendesk
zendesk.description: Zendesk, Inc. is a software-as-a-service company headquartered in San Francisco, California. Founded in 2007, it provides products related to customer support, sales, and communications, and was previously publicly traded before being taken private.

zoom-communications.name: Zoom Communications
zoom-communications.description: Zoom Communications, Inc. is an American communications technology company headquartered in San Jose, California. It is primarily known for its videoconferencing platform, Zoom.

zynga.name: Zynga
zynga.description: Zynga Inc. is an American video game developer and publisher founded in 2007, known for social video game services. It is owned by Take-Two Interactive since 2022 and is headquartered in San Mateo, California, focusing on mobile and social networking platforms.

ziprecruiter.name: ZipRecruiter
ziprecruiter.description: ZipRecruiter, Inc. is an American employment marketplace connecting job seekers and employers. It operates in the software industry.

zealand-pharma.name: Zealand Pharma
zealand-pharma.description: Zealand Pharma A/S is a Danish biotechnology research company that designs and develops peptide-based medicines, focusing on metabolic diseases like diabetes and obesity. Its head office is located in Søborg near Copenhagen. In 2018, Zealand Pharma opened a subsidiary in the United States and is part of the Danish-Swedish life science cluster Medicon Valley.

zto-express.name: ZTO Express
zto-express.description: ZTO Express is a logistics company headquartered in Shanghai, China. It is one of the largest courier services in China and is dual listed on the New York Stock Exchange and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.

zojirushi-corporation.name: Zojirushi Corporation
zojirushi-corporation.description: Zojirushi Corporation is a Japanese multinational manufacturer of vacuum flasks, beverage dispensers, and consumer electronics like rice cookers and electric kettles. It has branches and subsidiaries across Asia and the US and is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

zeria-pharmaceutical.name: Zeria Pharmaceutical
zeria-pharmaceutical.description: Zeria Shinyaku Kōgyō KK is a Japanese drug manufacturer that acquired Tillotts Pharma AG. The company operates in the pharmaceutical sector and is based in Japan.

zain-saudi-arabia.name: Zain Saudi Arabia
zain-saudi-arabia.description: Mobile Telecommunication Company Saudi Arabia, known as Zain Saudi Arabia, is a telecommunications and digital services company. It offers telecom services including 5G, digital payments, cloud computing, and IoT solutions, and is part of the Kuwaiti Zain Group.

zamil-industrial.name: Zamil Industrial
zamil-industrial.description: Zamil Industrial Investment Co., known as Zamil Industrial, is a publicly listed company based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. It develops materials and equipment for the construction industry and is partly owned by Zamil Group Holding Company.

zagrebacka-banka.name: Zagrebačka banka
zagrebacka-banka.description: Zagrebačka Banka, also known as ZABA, is the largest bank in Croatia. It is owned by the Milan-based UniCredit. The bank plays a significant role in the Croatian banking sector.

zhihu.name: Zhihu
zhihu.description: Zhihu is a Chinese social question and answer site and news aggregator originally based in Chengdu. Launched in 2011, it has developed features similar to Reddit and is often compared to Quora. It serves a large user base in China.

zulily.name: Zulily
zulily.description: Zulily is an American e-commerce website headquartered in Midvale, Utah. It targets young mothers interested in brand-name goods for their children.

zymeworks.name: Zymeworks
zymeworks.description: Zymeworks Inc. is a publicly held biotechnology company based in Vancouver, British Columbia. It develops protein therapeutics for cancer and autoimmune diseases and held the largest Canadian biotech IPO in over a decade in 2017.

zynex.name: Zynex
zynex.description: Zynex, Inc. is a medical device manufacturer founded in 1996 by Thomas Sandgaard. The company produces and markets electrotherapy devices used in pain management, physical rehabilitation, neurological diagnosis, and cardiac monitoring.

zhong-tong-bus.name: Zhong Tong Bus
zhong-tong-bus.description: Zhongtong Bus Holding Co., Ltd. is a Chinese bus manufacturing company based in Liaocheng, Shandong Province. It is listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange and is one of China's major bus makers.

zijin-mining-group.name: Zijin Mining Group
zijin-mining-group.description: Zijin Mining Group Co., Limited is a publicly traded partly state-owned mining company headquartered in Longyan, Fujian, China. It is one of the largest producers of gold, copper, and zinc in China, with operations across Asia, Africa, Europe, and the Americas.

zimmer-biomet-holdings.name: Zimmer Biomet Holdings
zimmer-biomet-holdings.description: Zimmer Biomet Holdings, Inc. is a publicly traded American medical device company founded in 1927. It was originally established to produce aluminum splints and is headquartered in Warsaw, Indiana, part of a medical devices business cluster.

zions-bancorporation.name: Zions Bancorporation
zions-bancorporation.description: Zions Bancorporation is an American national bank headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah. It operates under seven brands including Zions Bank and Amegy Bank of Texas, functioning as a national bank rather than a bank holding company.

zoran-corporation.name: Zoran Corporation
zoran-corporation.description: Zoran Corporation was a multinational digital technology company founded in 1981 and headquartered in Silicon Valley. It focused on designing and selling SoC integrated circuits for consumer electronics and had offices worldwide, including a strong R&D presence in Israel.

zebra-technologies.name: Zebra Technologies
zebra-technologies.description: Zebra Technologies Corporation is an American multinational technology conglomerate specializing in smart data capture systems. The company is commonly known as Zebra.

zyxel.name: Zyxel
zyxel.description: Zyxel Communications Corporation is a Taiwanese multinational broadband provider headquartered in Hsinchu Science Park, Taiwan. Founded in 1989, it has multiple research centers, regional headquarters, and branch offices worldwide.

zerofox.name: ZeroFox
zerofox.description: ZeroFox Holdings, Inc. is an American external cybersecurity company based in Baltimore, Maryland. It provides cloud-based software as a service to help organizations detect and disrupt various cyber threats. The company operates in the technology sector focused on computer security.

zydus-cadila.name: Zydus Cadila
zydus-cadila.description: Zydus Lifesciences Limited, formerly Cadila Healthcare Limited, is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Ahmedabad, India. It primarily manufactures generic drugs and was ranked 100th in the Fortune India 500 list in 2020.

zenrin.name: Zenrin
zenrin.description: Zenrin Co. Ltd. is a Japanese map publishing company founded in 1948 in Beppu, Kyūshū. It specializes in residential maps and software for personal computers and automotive navigation systems. Zenrin is a leading company in Japan for mapping software production.

zqgame.name: ZQGame
zqgame.description: ZQGame, based in Shenzhen, China, develops massively multiplayer online games along with browser and mobile games. It was listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2010 and formed a joint venture with Shanda in the Shanghai Pilot Free-Trade Zone in 2013.

z-energy.name: Z Energy
z-energy.description: Z Energy is a New Zealand-based fuel distributor operating branded service stations. Since May 2022, it has been a subsidiary of Australian petroleum company Ampol and owns some former assets of Shell New Zealand and Chevron New Zealand.

zensho-holdings.name: Zensho Holdings
zensho-holdings.description: Zensho Holdings is a Japanese holding company that owns several restaurant chains in Japan. Its largest chain is Sukiya, which serves gyūdon, rice bowls with beef.

zevia.name: Zevia
zevia.description: Zevia is a Los Angeles-based company producing soft drinks, organic tea, energy drinks, and mixers sweetened with stevia. All products are zero-calorie, sugar-free, gluten free, vegan, kosher, and Non-GMO Project certified. In June 2021, Zevia filed to go public with an IPO.

zhaojin-mining.name: Zhaojin Mining
zhaojin-mining.description: Zhaojin Mining Industry Company Limited is a leading gold mining enterprise in China engaged in gold exploration, mining, processing, refining, and smelting. It is a joint venture between Zhaojin Group and Fosun International and is headquartered in Zhaoyuan, Shandong Province.

zhejiang-expressway-company.name: Zhejiang Expressway Company
zhejiang-expressway-company.description: Zhejiang Expressway Company Limited is an infrastructure company in China that invests in, develops, and operates expressways in Zhejiang Province. It also operates related businesses such as automobile servicing, gas stations, and billboard advertising along expressways.

zhongjin-gold.name: Zhongjin Gold
zhongjin-gold.description: Zhongjin Gold Corporation Limited is a major Chinese mining company primarily producing gold, copper, and other non-ferrous metals. The company is headquartered in Beijing and listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

zillow.name: Zillow
zillow.description: Zillow Group, Inc. is an American tech real-estate marketplace company founded in 2006 by former Microsoft executives and other tech entrepreneurs. The company operates in the real estate sector using technology to facilitate property transactions.

zions-bank.name: Zions Bank
zions-bank.description: Zions Bancorporation is an American national bank headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah. It operates as a national bank rather than a bank holding company and conducts business under seven brands including Zions Bank and Amegy Bank of Texas. It serves multiple states through its various regional banks.

ziprealty.name: ZipRealty
ziprealty.description: ZipRealty was a website offering real estate listings in the United States. It was acquired by Realogy in 2014 and later integrated into the Coldwell Banker subsidiary. The company operated in the real estate sector before its acquisition.

zoetis.name: Zoetis
zoetis.description: Zoetis Inc. is headquartered in Parsippany, New Jersey, and is the largest global producer of medicine and vaccinations for pets and livestock. Its products include vaccines, antiparasitics, and various therapeutics for animal health. The company operates in over 50 countries worldwide.

zomato.name: Zomato
zomato.description: Zomato is an Indian online food ordering and delivery service owned by Eternal Limited. Founded in 2008, it started as a restaurant aggregator and expanded to over 20 countries by 2015. Food delivery became its core business after entering the market in India in 2015.

zoominfo.name: ZoomInfo
zoominfo.description: ZoomInfo Technologies Inc. is a data broker registered in the United States that collects and sells personal and business data. It gathers information through data and web scraping and offers it for targeted marketing purposes. The company provides data on business entities and individuals.

zoom-telephonics.name: Zoom Telephonics
zoom-telephonics.description: Zoom Telephonics, Inc. was an American networking company founded in 1977 by two MIT graduates. After merging with Minim, Inc. in 2020, it moved its headquarters to Manchester, New Hampshire and focused on home networking products. In 2024, Minim was acquired by e2Companies, an energy management firm.

zscaler.name: Zscaler
zscaler.description: Zscaler, Inc. is an American cloud security company based in San Jose, California. It provides cloud-based services designed to protect enterprise networks and data. The company operates in the internet security sector.

zumiez.name: Zumiez
zumiez.description: Zumiez Inc. is an American multinational specialty clothing retailer founded in 1978 and based in Lynnwood, Washington. It sells apparel, footwear, accessories, and hardgoods focused on action sports like skateboarding and snowboarding. The company targets young men and women.

zuora.name: Zuora
zuora.description: Zuora, Inc. is an American enterprise software company headquartered in Redwood City, California. It provides software to help businesses launch and manage subscription-based services, automating billing, collections, quoting, and revenue recognition. Its applications focus on subscription metrics and management.

zoom-corporation.name: Zoom Corporation
zoom-corporation.description: Zoom Corporation is a Japan-based audio company specializing in the design and development of electronic devices for music. Established in 1983, its products are sold worldwide and it is listed on the JASDAQ market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

zaffari.name: Zaffari
zaffari.description: Companhia Zaffari is a Brazilian company operating a chain of supermarkets and hypermarkets primarily in Rio Grande do Sul and São Paulo. It is recognized as the tenth largest company in Brazil. The company focuses on retail operations within the country.

zakady-chemiczne-police.name: Zakłady Chemiczne Police
zakady-chemiczne-police.description: Grupa Azoty Zakłady Chemiczne "Police" S.A. is a Polish chemical synthesis company based in Police, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland.

zimbabwe-red-cross-society.name: Zimbabwe Red Cross Society
zimbabwe-red-cross-society.description: Zimbabwe Red Cross Society (ZRCS) is a humanitarian organization founded in 1981 by an act of the Zimbabwe Parliament. It is headquartered in Harare, Zimbabwe. The society focuses on emergency and relief efforts within the country.

zona-franca-of-iquique.name: Zona Franca of Iquique
zona-franca-of-iquique.description: The Zona Franca de Iquique is a free-trade zone located in the coastal port city of Iquique, in the Tarapacá Region of northwestern Chile. It serves as a special economic area facilitating trade and logistics in the region.

zhejiang-wanma.name: Zhejiang Wanma
zhejiang-wanma.description: Zhejiang Wanma Co., Ltd. is a Chinese manufacturer specializing in electricity transmission lines and distribution networks. Founded in 2009 as a listed company, it also formed a joint venture in 2017 for rental of electricity-powered logistics vehicles. The company is based in China and was part of the SZSE 100 and later SZSE 200 Index.

zil.name: ZiL
zil.description: ZiL, or Public Joint-Stock Company – Likhachov Plant, was an automobile manufacturer based in the Danilovsky District of Moscow, Russia. It operated from 1916 to 2012 and was best known for producing limousines used by the Soviet Union elite, which led to the term 'ZiL lanes'.

zakady-azotowe-puawy.name: Zakłady Azotowe Puławy
zakady-azotowe-puawy.description: Grupa Azoty Zakłady Azotowe Puławy PLC is a Polish chemical company based in Puławy, Lublin Voivodeship. It specializes in nitrogen fertilizer production and is one of the world's largest melamine producers, also producing caprolactam, hydrogen peroxide, AdBlue, and technical gases.

zanair.name: ZanAir
zanair.description: ZanAir Limited is a domestic airline based in Zanzibar, Tanzania. Founded in 1992, it operates within Tanzania and is currently listed among airlines banned in the European Union.

zambia-national-commercial-bank.name: Zambia National Commercial Bank
zambia-national-commercial-bank.description: Zambia National Commercial Bank, commonly called Zanaco, is a commercial bank licensed by the Bank of Zambia. It operates in Zambia's financial services sector and was the first bank in Zambia to register a profit after tax of ZMW1bn in 2021.

zesco.name: ZESCO
zesco.description: ZESCO is a state-owned power company in Zambia and the largest power producer in the country. It generates approximately 80% of Zambia's electricity consumption and represents Zambia in the Southern African Power Pool.

zamtel.name: Zamtel
zamtel.description: Zamtel, officially Zambia Telecommunications Company Limited, is a government-owned telecommunications service provider in Zambia. It is one of three mobile phone networks operating in the country alongside Airtel and MTN.

zambia-airways.name: Zambia Airways
zambia-airways.description: Zambia Airways is the flag carrier airline of the Republic of Zambia. It is based in Lusaka with its hub at Kenneth Kaunda International Airport, serving the country's air transport needs.

zambia-skyways.name: Zambia Skyways
zambia-skyways.description: Zambia Skyways was an airline based in Lusaka, Zambia, originally known as Eastern Air. It began operations in 1993 and expanded its fleet in 1997 with the addition of a Let 410 aircraft.

zambia-red-cross-society.name: Zambia Red Cross Society
zambia-red-cross-society.description: The Zambia Red Cross Society is a humanitarian organization established in 1966 by an act of the Zambian Parliament. It originated as a branch of the British Red Cross and is headquartered in Lusaka, Zambia.

zimbabwe-defence-industries.name: Zimbabwe Defence Industries
zimbabwe-defence-industries.description: Zimbabwe Defence Industries (Pty) Ltd is a state-owned arms manufacturing and procurement company headquartered in Harare, Zimbabwe. It focuses on sporting and military ammunition and has historically produced various military equipment. The company has also been involved in arms deals and currently exports second-hand military equipment.
